title: Reef and Wreck
note: Cutaway showcase film 4 (ocean, travel, adventure, tourism), 16:9. A small tropical island on a block of clear sea; through the glass cut faces: light rays, a coral reef with anemones, a school of fish that turns together, a sea turtle, a sunken wooden ship and an open chest of gold; a diver rolls off a little boat and swims down to the chest. Three shots (arrive, descent, wreck). Blender Cutaway kit + cinematic extras (imported). Sound: real nature recordings only (see NOTES.md events table).
